title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery submits for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365-Day Firm Transporation Service Agreement with Briknell & Fuller, Inc.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul B. Vasington, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, James Connelly, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 02-26)
